behaviors_asserted: A route segment '*' acts as a wildcard path parameter accessible via c.req.param().
The wildcard capture may contain multiple path segments and does not include the separating '/' between the route and the captured part.
The wildcard capture is empty when the wildcard matches no additional path (e.g. '/a/*' with '/a' or '/a/').
The wildcard is a distinct path segment and does not match partial segments (e.g. '/a/*' does not match '/ab').
Patterns '/*' or '*' capture the entire request path without the leading '/'.
